verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community tuning tip that the default refresh interval is 1 second. That implies newly indexed documents become searchable within about a second without a reindex. First-party docs only show documents being ingested and embedded incrementally on index, with no mention of refresh semantics. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of near-real-time search and refresh behavior, evidence that updates and deletes become visible without a reindex, and independent hands-on corroboration of latency.
